render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {

  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
stadester_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON("migration_period_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
raw_keys <- vapply(stadester_data, function(e) as.character(e$key), character(1))
unique_keys <- unique(raw_keys)
all_entries <- lapply(unique_keys, function(k) {
  base_e <- if (!is.null(stadester_data[[k]])) stadester_data[[k]] else stadester_data[[which(raw_keys == k)[1]]]
  sub_entries <- stadester_data[raw_keys == k]
  merged_pop <- list()
  for (se in sub_entries) {
    if (!is.null(se$population)) {
      for (yr in names(se$population)) {
        merged_pop[[yr]] <- se$population[[yr]]
      }
    }
  }
  base_e$population <- merged_pop
  base_e
})

fmt_eu_pop <- function(val) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(val)
  if (v <= 0) return("-")
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", format(m, nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE))
    s <- sub(",00$", "", s)
    s <- sub("(,[1-9])0$", "\\1", s)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    if (k == floor(k)) {
      return(paste0(as.integer(k), "k"))
    }
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(k, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function(x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

get_entry_pop <- function(entry, yr_str) {
  p <- entry$population[[yr_str]]
  if (is.null(p)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(p)
}

get_occupied_span <- function(entry) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(entry$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  paste0(min(yrs), "-", max(yrs), "AD")
}

hyphenate_settlement_name <- function(nm) {
  s <- as.character(nm)
  exact_map <- c(
    "Kuznetsovskoye" = "Kuznetsov-skoye",
    "Dmitrievskoye" = "Dmitriev-skoye",
    "Mutenkovskoye" = "Mutenkov-skoye",
    "Koshbeevskoye" = "Koshbeev-skoye",
    "Mikhailovskoye-Yaroslavl" = "Mikhailov-skoye-Yaroslavl",
    "Petrovskoye-Yaroslavl" = "Petrov-skoye-Yaroslavl",
    "Kushnarenkovo" = "Kushnaren-kovo",
    "Kudymkarskoye" = "Kudymkar-skoye",
    "Karnaukhovskoye" = "Karnaukhov-skoye",
    "Arkhangelskoye" = "Arkhangel-skoye",
    "Shcherbinskoye" = "Shcherbin-skoye",
    "Rozhdestvenskoye" = "Rozhdest-venskoye",
    "Semikarakorskoye" = "Semikara-korskoye",
    "Rafailovskoye" = "Rafailov-skoye",
    "Kurumchinskoye" = "Kurumchin-skoye",
    "Pravoberezhnoye Tsimlyanskoye" = "Pravoberezh-noye Tsimlyan-skoye",
    "Mikhailovskiy Kordon" = "Mikhailov-skiy Kordon",
    "Staryeurutskoye" = "Staryeurut-skoye",
    "Maklasheyevka II" = "Maklashe-yevka II",
    "Maklasheevka II" = "Maklashe-evka II",
    "Bolshie Tarkhany" = "Bolshie Tar-khany",
    "Shcherbetskiy Ostrov" = "Shcherbet-skiy Ostrov",
    "Bolshoye Gordeevskoye" = "Bolshoye Gordeev-skoye",
    "Nisimkovichi" = "Nisimko-vichi",
    "Rozhdestveno-Volga" = "Rozhdest-veno-Volga",
    "Suvorovskoye" = "Suvorov-skoye",
    "Sukho-Chaltyrskoye" = "Sukho-Chaltyr-skoye"
  )
  if (s %in% names(exact_map)) return(unname(exact_map[[s]]))
  s
}

hyphenate_cyrillic_oth <- function(s) {
  out <- as.character(s)
  out <- gsub("\u0441\u043a\u043e\u0435", "-\u0441\u043a\u043e\u0435", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439", "-\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u0435\u0432\u043a\u0430", "-\u0435\u0432\u043a\u0430", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u043d\u043a\u043e\u0432\u043e", "\u043d-\u043a\u043e\u0432\u043e", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u043a\u043e\u0432\u0438\u0447\u0438", "\u043a\u043e-\u0432\u0438\u0447\u0438", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u0442\u044b\u043d\u0446\u0435\u0432\u043e", "\u0442\u044b\u043d-\u0446\u0435\u0432\u043e", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u0442\u0432\u0435\u043d-\u0441\u043a\u043e\u0435", "\u0442-\u0432\u0435\u043d-\u0441\u043a\u043e\u0435", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u0442\u0432\u0435\u043d\u043e", "\u0442-\u0432\u0435\u043d\u043e", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u043a\u0430\u0440\u0430\u043a\u043e\u0440-\u0441\u043a\u043e\u0435", "\u043a\u0430\u0440\u0430-\u043a\u043e\u0440-\u0441\u043a\u043e\u0435", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("\u0431\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0436\u043d\u043e\u0435", "\u0431\u0435-\u0440\u0435\u0436-\u043d\u043e\u0435", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out <- gsub("gorodishche", "goro-dishche", out, fixed = TRUE)
  out
}

build_slice_df <- function(idx_vec) {
  sub_list <- all_entries[idx_vec]
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function(e) {
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    if (length(raw_oth) > 1) {
      keep_oth <- raw_oth[1]
      for (nm in raw_oth[-1]) {
        words <- unlist(strsplit(nm, "\\s+"))
        if (max(nchar(words)) <= 11 && length(keep_oth) < 2) {
          keep_oth <- c(keep_oth, nm)
        }
      }
      oth <- paste(keep_oth, collapse = "; ")
    } else if (length(raw_oth) == 1) {
      oth <- raw_oth[1]
    } else {
      oth <- "-"
    }
    oth <- hyphenate_cyrillic_oth(oth)
    coords_span <- paste0(
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]),
      " (", get_occupied_span(e), ")"
    )
    data.frame(
      `Settlement` = hyphenate_settlement_name(e$name),
      `Historical / Native Names` = oth,
      `Coords & Span` = coords_span,
      `250` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "250")),
      `350` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "350")),
      `450` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "450")),
      `600` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "600")),
      `750` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "750")),
      `900` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "900")),
      `1900` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1900")),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles population estimates for 198 excavated settlements across Belarus, Ukraine and Russia (excluding the Baltic provinces) from the Late Roman period (250AD) to the First All-Russian Census of 1897 (1900AD). Arranged across six ecological zones - the European forest-steppe, the mixed and boreal forests, the Middle Volga and Kama-Urals, the open Pontic-Caspian steppe, the North Caucasus and Siberia - the tables trace how village life shifted when the Huns broke up the eastern Chernyakhov and Late Sarmatian settlements in the 370s AD. While open steppe camps and exposed southern border villages shrank or moved between 350AD and 450AD, fortified hillforts (*gorodishcha*), woodland river villages (*selishcha*) and terraced mountain strongholds grew steadily from the fifth to the tenth centuries AD, laying the urban foundations of early medieval Rus', Volga Bulgaria and the Caucasian frontier.

# Methodology

This gazetteer brings together 198 excavated Migration Period (c. 250-750AD) and early medieval settlements - promontory hillforts (*gorodishcha*), river-terrace villages (*selishcha*) and steppe strongholds - across the six regions of Belarus, Ukraine and Russia (excluding the Baltic provinces). Together they trace the shift of population from the open Pontic-Caspian steppe into the woodland valleys of the Dnieper, Oka, Upper and Middle Volga, Kama and North Caucasus.

For each site, population estimates across the Migration Period (250, 350, 450, 600 and 750AD) and the early medieval transition (900AD) are worked out from excavated house counts, fortified and open settlement areas and cemetery grave totals [@oblomskiy2016kolochinskaya; @krenke2019moskvorechye; @goldina1999drevnyaya; @gadzhiev2002derbent]. Dates before a settlement was founded or after it was abandoned are marked with a hyphen (-). Where an ancient hillfort or village grew into a lasting town or village on the same spot, its population at the First All-Russian Census of 1897 (1900AD) is given in the final column [@troinitsky1905perepis].

# Results

## European Forest-Steppe Settlements

Table \ref{tab:reg1-sites} lists 38 excavated settlements across the Seim, Psel, Upper Don, Oskol and Desna forest-steppe valleys, covering the Kiev, Eastern Chernyakhov, Kolochin, Penkovka, Volyntsevo-Romny, Borshevo and Saltovo-Mayaki cultures [@shchukin2005gotskiy; @oblomskiy2002dneprovskoe; @oblomskiy2016kolochinskaya; @sedov1999drevnerusskaya].

```{r table-reg1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg1 <- build_slice_df(1:38)
render_table_template(
  df_reg1,
  list(
    caption = "Excavated settlements across the Dnieper, Desna, Seim and Upper Don forest-steppe from 250AD to 1900AD, showing the transition from large Chernyakhov plough-farming villages to Kolochin, Penkovka and early Slavic hillforts.",
    label = "tab:reg1-sites"
  )
)
```

## Mixed and Boreal Forest Zone Settlements

Table \ref{tab:reg2-sites} lists 55 excavated hillforts, river villages and early towns across the Moskva, Upper and Middle Oka, Upper Volga, Ilmen-Volkhov, Pskov and Upper Dnieper forest basins, spanning the Late Dyakovo, Moshchiny, Ryazan-Oka, Tushemlya, Pskov Long Barrows, Merya, Muroma and Early Rus' traditions [@krenke2011dyakovo; @mayorov2016moschiny; @akhmedov2018ryazan; @lopatin2007severnye; @islanova2012ozero].

```{r table-reg2, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg2 <- build_slice_df(39:93)
render_table_template(
  df_reg2,
  list(
    caption = "Excavated promontory hillforts, lakeshore hamlets and early medieval trading towns across the Moskva-Oka, Upper Volga, Ilmen and Upper Dnieper forest basins from 250AD to 1900AD.",
    label = "tab:reg2-sites"
  )
)
```

## Middle Volga, Kama-Vyatka and Cis-Ural Settlements

Table \ref{tab:reg3-sites} lists 44 excavated hillforts and villages across the Samara Bend, Middle Volga, Kama, Vyatka, Belaya and Sylva basins, covering the Imenkovo, Azelino, Mazunino, Turaevo, Bakhmutino, Turbasly, Kushnarenkovo, Nevolino, Lomovatovo and Polom cultures [@vyazov2019middle; @goldina1999drevnyaya; @goldina2012nevolino; @bakhshiev2017bakhmutino; @nazarov2025lomovatovo].

```{r table-reg3, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg3 <- build_slice_df(94:137)
render_table_template(
  df_reg3,
  list(
    caption = "Excavated Imenkovo plough-farming clusters on the Middle Volga and Permic-Ugrian hillforts across the Kama, Vyatka and Belaya basins from 250AD to 1900AD.",
    label = "tab:reg3-sites"
  )
)
```

## Open Pontic-Caspian Steppe Settlements

Table \ref{tab:reg4-sites} lists 16 excavated trading ports, winter camps, river-delta towns and Khazar brick and stone forts across the Lower Don, Lower Volga and Southern Trans-Ural steppe [@shchukin2005gotskiy; @botalov2009gunny; @kazanski2020steppe].

```{r table-reg4, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg4 <- build_slice_df(138:153)
render_table_template(
  df_reg4,
  list(
    caption = "Excavated trading ports, winter camps and Khazar river fortresses across the Lower Don, Lower Volga and Pontic-Caspian steppe from 250AD to 1900AD.",
    label = "tab:reg4-sites"
  )
)
```

## North Caucasus and Caspian Corridor Settlements

Table \ref{tab:reg5-sites} lists 22 excavated fortress towns, mountain strongholds and coastal settlements across Dagestan, the Central Caucasus (Alanian Kislovodsk and Kuban valleys) and the Taman-Black Sea coast [@gadzhiev2002derbent; @gmyrya2022palasa; @korobov2013terraced; @mastykova2009kuban].

```{r table-reg5, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg5 <- build_slice_df(154:175)
render_table_template(
  df_reg5,
  list(
    caption = "Excavated Alanian cliff forts in the Kislovodsk and Kuban valleys, Black Sea ports and Sassanian-era walled towns along the Dagestan coast from 250AD to 1900AD.",
    label = "tab:reg5-sites"
  )
)
```

## Western and Southern Siberian Settlements

Table \ref{tab:reg6-sites} lists 23 excavated hillforts, iron-working villages and herding settlements across the Tobol-Irtysh, Middle and Lower Ob, Minusinsk Basin, Russian Altai and Lake Baikal regions, covering the Sargat, Potchevash, Relka, Tashtyk, Bulan-Koby, Early Turkic and Kurykan traditions [@matveeva2000sargat; @zelenkov2025potchevash; @azbelev2007oglakhty; @seregin2021altai; @kharinsky2005baikal].

```{r table-reg6, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg6 <- build_slice_df(176:198)
render_table_template(
  df_reg6,
  list(
    caption = "Excavated taiga hillforts, irrigated Minusinsk farming villages and Altai-Baikal iron-smelting settlements across Western and Southern Siberia from 250AD to 1900AD.",
    label = "tab:reg6-sites"
  )
)
```

# Appendix

## Regional Gazetteer Summary

Table \ref{tab:regional-summary} sums the catalogued settlements and their combined population across the six regions from 250AD to 1900AD.

```{r table-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
reg_defs <- list(
  list(name = "1. European Forest-Steppe", idx = 1:38),
  list(name = "2. Mixed and Boreal Forest Zone", idx = 39:93),
  list(name = "3. Middle Volga, Kama-Vyatka and Cis-Urals", idx = 94:137),
  list(name = "4. Open Pontic-Caspian Steppe", idx = 138:153),
  list(name = "5. North Caucasus and Caspian Corridor", idx = 154:175),
  list(name = "6. Western and Southern Siberia", idx = 176:198)
)
bench_yrs <- c("250", "350", "450", "600", "750", "900", "1900")

sum_rows <- lapply(reg_defs, function(rd) {
  sub_e <- all_entries[rd$idx]
  sums <- sapply(bench_yrs, function(y) {
    vals <- sapply(sub_e, function(e) {
      v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
      if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
    })
    fmt_eu_pop(sum(vals))
  })
  data.frame(
    `Region (Sites)` = paste0(rd$name, " (", length(rd$idx), " sites)"),
    `250AD` = sums[["250"]],
    `350AD` = sums[["350"]],
    `450AD` = sums[["450"]],
    `600AD` = sums[["600"]],
    `750AD` = sums[["750"]],
    `900AD` = sums[["900"]],
    `1900AD` = sums[["1900"]],
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_sums <- sapply(bench_yrs, function(y) {
  vals <- sapply(all_entries, function(e) {
    v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
    if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
  })
  fmt_eu_pop(sum(vals))
})
tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Sites)` = paste0("All Six Regions (", length(all_entries), " sites)"),
  `250AD` = tot_sums[["250"]],
  `350AD` = tot_sums[["350"]],
  `450AD` = tot_sums[["450"]],
  `600AD` = tot_sums[["600"]],
  `750AD` = tot_sums[["750"]],
  `900AD` = tot_sums[["900"]],
  `1900AD` = tot_sums[["1900"]],
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(df_sum, tot_row)

render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Combined population of the 198 excavated settlements across the six ecological zones from 250AD to the 1897 census.",
    label = "tab:regional-summary"
  )
)
```
